name: Baylor College of Medicine crystallography core: Formulatrix ROCK IMAGER 2 (NIH S10; 2021)
brief: A crystallography core replaces a 2008 imaging system with an automated crystallization-plate imager with a dual light path, capable of visible, ultraviolet and multi-fluorescence imaging of high-throughput screening plates.

cost.excludes_note: NIH S10 award for the imager alone; any institutional match is not stated.

notes: Out-of-sample: found after the cost model was frozen at commit 02d7678 and scored blind against it (results in docs/validation.md). Later model or catalog changes do not count as out-of-sample for this case. price_basis=configured, from the wording "ROCK IMAGER 2 with Dual Light Path and capable of both ultraviolet (UV) and multi-fluorescence imaging" (options included). Verified 3 Oct 2026 via NIH RePORTER API (1S10OD030246-01, award_amount 136284; https://reporter.nih.gov/project-details/10176250). Quote: "This application is requesting funds to purchase a Formulatrix ROCK IMAGER 2 with Dual Light Path and capable of both ultraviolet (UV) and multi-fluorescence imaging". Proxy match: Rock Imager 2 vs catalog formulatrix_rock_imager_1000 (the 1000 is the larger-capacity model; the ROCK IMAGER 2 capacity is not stated in the abstract).

equipment.rationale: Closest catalog model to the bought model (proxy).
